title: DynaFix: Iterative Automated Program Repair Driven by Execution-Level Dynamic Information
abstract: arXiv:2512.24635v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) seeks to generate correct patches for buggy programs, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based repair systems remain sensitive to superficial code changes and often rely on coarse test outcomes during iterative repair. We propose DynaFix, an LLM-based APR framework that integrates execution-level dynamic information into a closed-loop repair workflow. The distinguishing feature of DynaFix lies not in using execution-level information per se, but in repeatedly updating and exploiting such information throughout the iterative repair process. In each repair round, DynaFix uses ByteTrace to collect variable states, branch paths, and call stacks, incorporates these runtime signals into structured prompts, validates generated patches through re-execution, and feeds the resulting updated traces into subsequent repair iterations. This process grounds patch generation in concrete execution behavior rath

translated_title: DynaFix：由执行层动态信息驱动的迭代式自动程序修复
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.24635v3 通告类型：replace-cross 摘要：自动程序修复（APR）旨在为有缺陷的程序生成正确的补丁，但近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的修复系统对表面代码变化较为敏感，并且在迭代修复过程中往往依赖粗糙的测试结果。我们提出DynaFix，一个基于LLM的APR框架，它将执行层动态信息集成到闭环修复工作流中。DynaFix的显著特点不在于使用执行层信息本身，而在于在整个迭代修复过程中反复更新并利用这些信息。在每一轮修复中，DynaFix使用ByteTrace收集变量状态、分支路径和调用栈，将这些运行时信号融入结构化提示中，通过重新执行来验证生成的补丁，并将由此获得的更新后的追踪信息反馈到后续的修复迭代中。这一过程使补丁生成立足于具体的执行行为，而非……（原文截断）
tldr: DynaFix的核心创新在于在迭代修复过程中反复收集（通过ByteTrace获取变量状态、分支路径和调用栈）并更新执行层动态信息，将其融入提示并以重执行验证补丁，形成闭环，使基于LLM的自动程序修复扎根于具体的运行时行为。
en_tdlr: DynaFix distinguishes itself by repeatedly updating and exploiting execution-level dynamic information (variable states, branch paths, and call stacks collected via ByteTrace) throughout iterative LLM-based repair, forming a closed loop that grounds patch generation and validation in concrete runtime behavior.
